Experience - CRT in Radiologic Technology and Flouroscopy required.
One year experience in hospital setting preffered.

Performs diagnostic x-ray medical procedures and C-Arm procedures for the neonatal, infant, pediatric, adolescent, adult and geriatric patient. Prepares room and patient and assists radiologists in fluoroscopic procedures. Ensures proper charges are captured on a daily basis. In addition, may be required to perform other duties as assigned. Under general direction performs a variety of radiographic procedures, and has a skilled technical level requiring the ability to apply prescribing imaging radiation for diagnosis. Performs related work as required. Some special procedures which requires the use of complex equipment occasionally. Direct and supervises quality control in the department. Reports to the Director of Imaging Services or designee of the department.
Education: Completion of a 24 month School of Radiologic Technology that is ARRT Recognized.
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Knowledge of University and Medical Center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
